asset.name: PageHeader
asset.description: The responsive title region carrying breadcrumbs, description, metadata, primary and overflow actions, optional tabs, and compact behavior as the page scrolls.

requires.reason: Title level is semantic and independent of visual scale.
Actions collapse into overflow through the shared group.
User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.

suggests.reason: Hierarchical surfaces need a path; a top-level page does not.
